text.description_html:
RK International BP-382, Flower Backplate for 3 Inch Cabinet Pulls

With a 3 inch center to center, this Fancy Flower Pull Backplate is suitable for use with any 3 inch c.c. cabinet pull but we like it best with the Fancy Flower Cabinet Pull. It is available in polished brass, satin nickel, and oil rubbed bronze finishes. The attention to detail within the floral design really elevates this cabinet rosette. It is an ornate piece without being too gaudy.

Specifications and Features of the RK International BP-382 Floral Cabinet Pull Rosette:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/8"
  • Width: 1-1/8"
  • Projection: 3/16"

Sold Individually
